notes: The dedicated Scene RenderSet contains one ground entity and one 1,024-instance Horse entity.
Every Horse instance reads RenderEntityID and RenderEntityInstanceID and evaluates all 15 frozen GLB morph targets.
The shadow and main Scene passes reuse the unique Set; the capture is intentionally single-sample with no MSAA emulation.
All three scenarios pass 36 oracle comparisons, 24 stability comparisons, and 36 cross-quadrant comparisons.
